description: Cassette slot misalignment affecting one specific slot number. Sensors clean.
tests: Root cause is POSITIONAL METADATA - nothing in the 590-sensor vector can express it
notes: Constructed scenario, not a real fab incident. SECOM and WM-811K are separate, unrelated datasets - any wafer-map/sensor pairing here is constructed. See PRD Section 9/15. Case study 3's sub-cases share one sensor profile by design — all channels quiet, because the absence of process signal IS the evidence. Max sensor delta between 3a/3b/3c is 0.2 sigma, so nothing in the evidence identifies WHICH handling mechanism occurred. The wording assertion therefore tests the handling mechanism family, not the sub-case variant: demanding 'cassette slot' from identical evidence tests vocabulary, not reasoning. Sub-case separation is still enforced by expected_category and the confidence ceilings.
